artworks.title: Saint Peter
artworks.description: This is a detailed black-and-white woodcut illustration of a group of figures gathered around a cross in a wooded setting with a castle in the background. The central scene features a large cross being carried or erected, with surrounding figures engaged in various activities. Some figures are in armor and others are holding tools. The background includes intricate details of a landscape with trees, architecture, and a fortified structure. The style is reminiscent of early Renaissance woodcuts, focusing on line work and shading for depth and texture.

artworks.title: Saint Andrew
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures engaged in various actions beneath a large tree. The drawing features a collection of detailed and intricately carved figures. The central focus is a tall, cloaked figure raised above the others. Surrounding this figure are armored individuals and others dressed in robes or gowns. The figures are gathered closely together, with some looking towards the central character. In the background, a rocky landscape with sparse vegetation is visible.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: This is a print depicting a pastoral scene with numerous cherubs interacting with nature. The print features a large tree in the center, surrounded by several small, winged cherubs who are either perched on its branches, playing among the leaves, or sitting with each other on the ground. Details give the tree a dynamic character, with its gnarled branches twisting in various directions. Below the tree, a woman sits, holding an infant. On the left, a man bends down towards her, holding the reigns of a donkey that stands next to him on the far left. In the background, the small shapes of buildings seem to indicate a distant town or village.

artworks.title: Martin Luther, Half-Length to the Left with a Book in his Hands
artworks.description: The image is a black and white illustration of a man from the waist up. He is in a frontal position with his hands holding an object with detailing on its cover. The man has a stern expression, with pronounced brow, deep-set eyes, and a slightly furrowed forehead. His hair is short and wavy, falling around his face. He is dressed in a fur-trimmed coat over a high-collared garment. To the right of the man is a depiction of Jesus Christ on the cross with the inscription "INRI" above the cross. In the upper left corner, there is a circular emblem, possibly a crest or symbol. The background is plain, emphasizing the man and the crucifixion scene.

artworks.title: Luther as 'Junker Jorg'
artworks.description: This print shows a man's head and shoulders in a three-quarter view, facing the left. He has deep-set eyes, a furrowed brow, and a long nose. The man has curly hair, a wavy beard parted down the middle, and a long, curling mustache. He is wearing a loose-fitting, high-necked garment. There are abstract cloud-like formations in the background, and the print is contained in a rectangular outline. Above it are several lines of text.

artworks.title: The Celestial Ladder of Saint Bonaventura
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene with intricate symbolic imagery. The artwork features a central figure at the top surrounded by a circular diagram containing various religious figures and symbols. Multiple texts, probably in German or Latin, are interwoven throughout the illustration. To the left and right of the central image, groups of people appear to be gathered. The intricate line work and use of hatching provide depth and texture. The upper part of the drawing features cherubs and angelic figures among clouds.

artworks.title: The Judgment of Paris
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval scene in a forest setting. The scene is detailed with forest foliage on top. There are armors and figures gathered under the trees. A knight in armor is seated or reclining with armor pieces nearby. Three figures are nearby, possibly interacting with the knight. A horse, also in armor, stands near the knight. Two shields hang from a tree branch. In the background, there are ancient buildings and a mountainous landscape. Birds fly in the sky. The drawing is intricate with fine lines, resembling a woodcut or engraving.

artworks.title: The Holy Kinship
artworks.description: The image is an intricate engraving depicting a group of individuals in various poses. It shows full-body representations of multiple figures, including women, children, and men, some of whom are standing and others seated. In the center, two women sit beside each other, holding an infant between them. Their facial features are shown with fine detail. One woman has long, flowing hair and a slight halo around her head, while the other woman wears a headdress. Both wear long, ornate robes that drape around them. On the left and right sides, there are groups of adults and children interacting. One elder man is kneeling down with a stick, engaging with two children. The men are dressed in long cloaks with varying types of headgear, and one of them holds a small covered dish or object. Behind them, a detailed architectural setting is visible, with a window on the left revealing a landscape with trees and a building in the distance. Above the group, a decorative motif with cherubs and scrollwork hangs from the ceiling, adding to the detailed and formal atmosphere of the engraving.

artworks.title: Bookplate of Scheurl and Tucher
artworks.description: The image is a woodcut engraving showing a person standing upright. The individual has a serene expression with detailed facial features and styled hair with a leafy headdress. They wear a gown with intricate designs and hold a cross pendant at waist level. Flanking the person are two coat of arms; one featuring a lion and the other a male head in stripes. The background is detailed linework.

artworks.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
artworks.description: The drawing features multiple figures holding swords in a tense, crowded scene. A central seated figure in robes is surrounded by others with swords raised above him. The composition includes diagonal lines, conveying movement and conflict. Architectural elements like a doorway and walls are visible in the background, with figures arranged in layers. A small dog is seen in the foreground. The artwork is detailed with fine lines and cross-hatching.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross Between the Virgin and Saint John
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The central figure is depicted on a wooden cross with a crown of thorns, and there are two sorrowful figures on the left and right. The background features a detailed landscape with hills and a distant settlement with a towered building. Rocks and bones are at the base of the cross. The style is intricate and detailed, resembling a woodcut or engraving.

artworks.title: Christ and the Woman of Samaria
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures at a well. The image depicts a hooded figure standing at a well alongside another figure drawing water from it. The well is detailed with a stone structure and a pointed roof adorned with heraldic emblems. The scene is set in a pastoral landscape with distant hills, abundant foliage, a village, and a fortress visible on the horizon. To the left, other figures are depicted approaching. The artist's line work is intricate, highlighting the textures of the clothing and natural surroundings.

artworks.title: Adam and Eve in Paradise
artworks.description: This black-and-white print shows two nude adults, a man and a woman, at the base of a tree, surrounded by animals. The man is positioned on the left, sitting on the ground beneath the tree. He is holding an apple in one hand, raising it to his mouth. He has a straight nose, curly hair, a curly beard and mustache, high cheekbones, and thin, arched eyebrows. The woman on the right is standing, one arm around the man's shoulders. Her other arm is reaching upward towards a branch above her head, picking an apple from the tree. She has long, wavy hair that falls to her waist, a small nose, a soft chin, and deep-set eyes. Both people are nude. Above her head, a snake coils around a tree branch, looking towards the apple she is picking. More apples are hanging from the tree, as well as two shields or crests on the left. A sign or paper is attached to the side of the tree. The people and the tree are surrounded by animals, including deer with large horns, a boar, a horse, and a lion. Birds fly in the clear sky. The background is filled with leaves and low bushes.

artworks.title: Frederick the Wise and John the Constant of Saxony
The Penance of Saint John Chrysostom
Saint James the Less
artworks.description: This print shows a chaotic scene filled with a crowd of people. On the right, several people stand on a low balcony that comes out from a stone wall. A bearded man dressed in a billowing cloak is bent over the front of the balcony, his arms outstretched in front of him towards the ground, and his mouth open. Behind him are several more men looking out at him, one appearing to grab his clothing, either to push him out or try to pull him back in. On the ground below, a crowd of people look up at the falling man. In the bottom left are some people wearing long robes, and in the bottom right is a person in a tunic with a sword strapped to their side, their body turned to the right, away from the balcony. In the background, behind the crowd, is another stone wall with some small shields or crests at the top. The background of the print is off-white paper.

artworks.title: Saint John in a Landscape
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on the ground, leaning against a rock, writing in a book. The person has a side-profile, facing slightly upwards, with wavy hair falling to the shoulders and a halo around their head. They wear long robes with pleated designs, holding a quill pen while writing in the book on their knees. Next to them is a large bird on a branch. The background displays a rocky landscape with a tree and, in the far distance, a town or castle with chimneys within mountainous terrain. Above, in a cloud, are two bearded figures looking down, accompanied by another bird.

artworks.title: A River in Ireland
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a calm river and a serene woodland scene. The horizon is high, beyond a cluster of trees. The etching style features detailed textures in the foliage and water. The color palette is sepia-toned. Near the viewer, the riverbank is lush with grass, transitioning into a forest across the water. A wooden fence is visible to the right. In the distance, more trees blend into the background to create a harmonious landscape view.

artworks.title: Holy Family with Saint Elizabeth and the Infant Saint John
artworks.artist: Giovanni Antonio da Brescia, after Andrea Mantegna
artworks.description: This image features four figures. An elderly woman is on the left, facing a young child. In the center, a seated woman holds a naked infant. On the right, a bearded man stands. The background is plain and shaded.

artworks.title: Hercules and Antaeus
artworks.artist: Giovanni Antonio da Brescia, after Andrea Mantegna
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two entwined figures standing on a piece of ground, surrounded by symbolic objects. The artwork depicts two muscular figures, with one figure holding the other aloft, their limbs interlaced. They are positioned near a barren tree, which has a plaque attached to it with Latin inscriptions. At the base of the tree, there is a shield with further inscriptions. The ground is adorned with a club and stylized floral motifs. The drawing employs fine lines to detail the muscles and expressions, giving the figures a sense of dynamic movement and emotion. There is also text running vertically alongside the tree.

artworks.title: Flagellation
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 42.5 x 39.3 cm (16 3/4 x 15 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This print shows a group of people in a space lined with columns and tall arches. In the middle of the print, a person is tied to a column. They have a beard, long hair, a bare chest, and a cloth tied around their waist. Their hands are behind their back, and there is a halo around their head. They are surrounded by other people who grab and kick and them. The surrounding people hold long whips above the central person. On the ground in front of the group are a discarded whip, a shallow bowl, and some thin blocks.

artworks.title: Man Seated Holding a Forked Staff
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed close to plate mark): 16.4 x 14.8 cm (6 7/16 x 5 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated with a slight forward tilt. He is muscular, with one leg bent and the other extended. His head is turned to the left in profile, revealing his facial features, which include a large nose, full beard, and curly hair. He appears naked except for a fabric drape over his shoulders. In his left hand, he holds a staff, and there is a plant with twisting vines near him. The background is a shaded rocky surface with no other details.

artworks.title: Discovery of Joseph's Cup
artworks.artist: Giovanni Antonio da Brescia after Baldassare Peruzzi

artworks.title: Ornamental Panel Inscribed "Victoria Augusta"
artworks.artist: Giovanni Antonio da Brescia after Nicoletto da Modena
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental design featuring mythological creatures and motifs. The artwork depicts a symmetrical arrangement with two central figures holding musical instruments, surrounded by acanthus leaves, griffins, and sphinxes. In the upper portion, there is a winged figure with a crown-like headdress carrying symbols or trophies. The design is detailed with decorative elements including floral patterns and architectural motifs. Throughout the drawing, there are various mythological creatures integrated into the composition.
